headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Q1 FY27 Financial Results (Consolidated)
summary: Q1 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹311,850 Cr (+25.4% YoY, +4.4% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹47,517 Cr (+10.8% YoY, margin 15.2%); PAT ₹23,196 Cr (-24.6% YoY, +12.7% QoQ).
raw_text: Q1 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹311,850 Cr (+25.4% YoY, +4.4% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹47,517 Cr (+10.8% YoY, margin 15.2%); PAT ₹23,196 Cr (-24.6% YoY, +12.7% QoQ).

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results (PDF p. 9 via vision, reported in ₹ crore).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from Operations (Net of GST/Excise) = ₹3,11,850 Cr.
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹3,11,850 Cr − Total Expenses ₹2,87,770 Cr = ₹24,080 Cr) + Finance Costs (₹8,337 Cr) + Depreciation, Depletion & Amortisation (₹15,100 Cr) = ₹47,517 Cr (15.24% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Tax (after Share of Profit of Associates/JVs; no exceptional items in Q1 FY27) = ₹30,630 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period = ₹23,196 Cr (Profit attributable to Owners of the Company = ₹20,946 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹2,250 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 9 via vision) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii
